propositions: Operators need a single reproducible report distinguishing packed object bytes, checkout logical bytes, checkout allocated bytes, and whole-clone footprint without conflating git packing with checkout residence or filesystem block slack.

An explicit opt-in read-only rebar tracker-footprint command must measure both mounted tracker mode (identifying shared object databases) and --fresh-clone mode (creating temporary single-branch clones with hardlink optimization disabled).

The footprint report must separate packed object bytes, checkout logical/allocated bytes with st_blocks-aware allocation slack, file count, git-directory logical/allocated bytes, and whole-clone totals; unsupported metrics must be structured unavailable values, never fabricated zeros.
Size measurements are descriptive only with no threshold, pass/fail classification, baseline mutation, alert side effect, or nonzero exit caused solely by a large result.
The command must never run implicitly from ticket writes, reconciliation, plan/completion gates, Gerrit Verify, or ordinary metrics collection.

Linked-worktree default mode must label its object database as shared rather than standalone, and fresh-clone failure must remove only command-owned temporary state without mutating source refs or remote state.
